licenceNote: Each photograph is someone else's work, used under the licence shown. A pandal is rebuilt every year on a new theme, so a photograph never shows what is standing today. Where the photograph carries GPS coordinates, build-data.mjs measures them against our pin and the app prints the distance, so a photograph doubles as evidence about the pin.
